title: Continuity from above: a density quotient dominated by σ(B_r(z)) has liminf at most σ({z})
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ. Let σ be a Borel measure on ℝ^P with σ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P, let z ∈ ℝ^P, and let f : ℝ → [0, ∞] satisfy f(r) ≤ ω_n·ofReal(rⁿ)·σ(B_r(z)) for every r > 0, where ω_n = unitBallVolume n and B_r(z) is the open ball. Then liminf_{r→0+} f(r)/(ω_n·ofReal(rⁿ)) ≤ σ({z}). The liminf is taken along the filter 𝓝[>] 0 on ℝ, and the quotient is division in [0, ∞].
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (σ : Measure (Euclid P)) (z : Euclid P) (f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → σ K < ∞) → (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → f r ≤ unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n) * σ (ball z r)) → liminf (fun r : ℝ => f r / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0) ≤ σ {z}
